Equips consumers with complete knowledge, legal tools, and direct action buttons to win. This allows you to resolve issues directly from your dashboard rather than navigating complex bureau dispute systems.

faqs.question: Will checking my credit on SmartCredit hurt my score?
faqs.answer: No. All credit report pulls and score tracking within SmartCredit are 100% soft inquiries. You can review your reports, run ScoreBoost simulations, and monitor weekly updates as often as you want without lowering your credit score by a single point.

faqs.question: How quickly can I see results with SmartCredit's ScoreBuilder and ScoreBoost?
faqs.answer: ScoreBoost simulations allow you to see immediate point improvements on your next statement closing cycle (often within 15 to 30 days) by strategically timing your payments. ScoreBuilder provides a structured 120-day roadmap designed to systematically challenge derogatory items and elevate your credit profile.
